subtitle: Analyze iconic rock riffs and understand their harmonic foundation, rhythmic patterns, and melodic construction

introduction.title: The DNA of Rock Music
introduction.text: Classic rock riffs combine blues heritage with modal harmony to create the sound that defined a generation. Understanding these riffs reveals how simple theoretical concepts can create maximum emotional impact and cultural significance.

columns.title: Power & Simplicity
columns.text: Rock riffs prove that complexity isn't required for impact - often the simplest ideas are the most memorable.

columns.title: Modal Flavors
columns.text: Rock frequently borrows from parallel minor keys, creating darker colors than pure major key music.

columns.title: Rhythmic Drive
columns.text: Rock riffs emphasize rhythm and groove as much as melody, creating visceral physical response.

steps.title: Foundation (Weeks 1-3)
steps.description: Master power chord shapes. Learn "Smoke on the Water". Practice palm muting technique. Understand I-bVII-IV progression.

steps.title: Technique (Weeks 4-6)
steps.description: String skipping techniques. Learn "Sweet Child O' Mine" intro. Alternate picking development. Chromatic riff patterns.

steps.title: Mastery (Weeks 7-8)
steps.description: Complex rhythm patterns. Create original riffs. Combine multiple techniques. Play with backing tracks.
